company.name: Kraftwerk Social
company.description: Paid social agency for regional retail and tourism businesses in Austria.

message.text: Hi, we are a paid social agency, 8 people, roughly €22k per month in revenue. Leads from our website and Instagram DMs go unanswered for days because everyone is busy in delivery. I have been quoted €12k by another shop and want to compare. Can we talk this month?
